name: SYNTH tab (the two oscillator captions and the ten envelope/filter/randomisation knob captions, every one of them written by setLabel from js/app.js and all of them behind a display:none tab-content)
EFFECTS tab (the four section titles, the four bypass faces and all fourteen effect knob captions — same shape, same reason)
the Chorus section BYPASSED (ui.off, the other face of the four bypass buttons — their resting face is ui.on, so no resting state shows it)

TUNING tab (the interval-list header with its {n} token substituted, the tonic caption, the five visualization buttons, A4 REF, Stretch, PB Range, the five file buttons and the scale generator — the whole panel js/tuning-panel.js injects)
the tuning LIBRARY expanded (its six filter options sit inside a .library-content that is collapsed at rest)
the scale generator expanded (Generate Scale's three type options, the EDO form's Divisions and Period captions and the Generate button all sit inside a collapsed .generator-content)

the generator switched to Harmonic Series (label.genStart and label.genEnd exist only in that form — setGeneratorType REBUILDS #generator-inputs, so no single state can show all three forms at once). Driven through the plugin's own <select> and its own change handler, not by calling the method: this is the state a user can actually produce.
the generator switched to Rank-2 Temperament (label.genGenerator and label.genCount, the last two captions of the third form)

the generator switched BACK to EDO (setGeneratorType REBUILDS #generator-inputs, so the Divisions and Period captions the resting markup carries are DESTROYED by the two states above and exist again only once the form is rebuilt — without this they report as never measured while being the form the panel opens on)
the ROTATION visualization (label.mode is the rotation table's first column header, written into an `html +=` accumulation and keyed afterwards — the one view no resting state renders)
the TRUE KEYS visualization (label.tkHint is the empty-state line inside #truekeys-view, which is display:none in every other mode)
back to the VOICE tab, so the dice menu and the preset chrome below are measured over the layout they actually open on
the DICE menu open (three captions and three descriptions inside a .dice-menu that is closed at rest)
the PRESET BROWSER open (its title, and the six category buttons renderCategories builds from scratch every time it is opened)

the preset browser CLOSED again — its overlay would otherwise sit over the save dialog and the settings popover below, and the popover's own dismiss handler closes it the moment a mousedown lands on anything it does not contain
the SAVE dialog open (its title, Cancel, Save, the five category options and the name placeholder — all inside a dialog that is closed at rest)
the save dialog CANCELLED — same reason: its backdrop covers the frame, so the settings popover opened next would be dismissed by the very click meant to reach the switch inside it

the settings popover OPEN (label.language, label.hoverHelp and the ui.off face of the switch are all inside a [hidden] panel). SECOND TO LAST on purpose: the popover's own dismiss handler closes it on a mousedown anywhere else, so opening it earlier would leave it shut by the time the switch below is clicked.

hover help ON (the ui.on face of the settings switch, which no resting state shows — hover help starts off). A real click on the real control, inside the popover the previous state opened, so the dismiss handler leaves the panel up.
